comment: Everything that changes the bits, besides the code; hashed into extractorHash with the sources (data/extractor_hash.ts). Nothing here is tied to one snapshot, so any campaign can use the extractor unchanged: the activity window is the windowDays before the snapshot block's timestamp, and okbUsd is a fixed reference price (Nov 18 2026, CoinGecko) that only converts OKB and USDT0 balances to one unit for the balance thresholds. exchanges lists known exchange addresses (none yet; exchange-scale funders are detected from their own history). history = the backend that reads wallet histories (okx | index).
